subject: Recap + final-week check: approval path & budget confirmation
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Adrian Klein <adrian.klein@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + final-week check: approval path & budget confirmation

Hi Adrian —

Great to meet earlier — appreciate you walking through Lumina's inference needs and the two main production use cases (real-time triage assistance and nightly batch report generation). Quick recap and next steps from my side: 

- What we covered: low-latency requirements for triage (<=150ms p50 target), batch embeddings for historical search, and data residency constraints for PHI.
- Proposed baseline: 2 dedicated GPUs (n1) for triage + scheduled batch workers for nightly runs; estimated starting run-rate ~250k tokens/day.
- Ask from Lumina: procurement timeline, required security evidence (SOC 2 + encryption at rest), and expected PO cadence.

Attached: Lumina_Draft_MAP_v1.pdf (brief mutual action plan) and a SOW-template.docx for procurement to review.

Next steps:
1) I'll share the MAP and a recommended configuration (attached).
2) Adrian — can you confirm who in procurement should receive the SOW first? You mentioned looping in a procurement contact.
3) If approval is on track this quarter, we can prioritize a 30-day pilot with canary traffic and a 10% discounted first-month committed rate.

If it helps, I can set a 20-minute call with Marcus (pricing lead) and Monica (solutions) — they can walk procurement through the SOW and timelines. Any chance procurement is available this week?

Thanks,

Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0113

Attachments: Lumina_Draft_MAP_v1.pdf (1.2MB), SOW-template.docx (85KB)

Thanks Avery — good summary.

I'll loop procurement in (cc'd). Two quick clarifications before we move the SOW:
- Can you confirm whether the triage nodes will store any plaintext PHI in logs by default? Our security team needs this spelled out.
- Ballpark cost: the initial commitment you mentioned — can you put a one‑paragraph pricing summary in the MAP so procurement can triage?

Procurement: I copied this thread so you have the MAP and SOW. Our preferred cadence is a typical 60-day PO window, but if we can keep this in Q3 then legal will prioritize review.

Happy to set a short call next week with procurement and your pricing lead.

Cheers,
Adrian Klein
